subject: Is there any parallel implementation of INLA  ?

messages.author: e677265a17505254
messages.subject: Is there any parallel implementation of INLA  ?
parts:
Hi All,

According to the initial paper by Rue, Martino, & Chopin (2009) on INLA, INLA can be implemented in parallel to use on  multicore processors or GPUs.

I would like to know whether there is a parallel version of INLA which can be run on multicore processors or GPUs.

Thank you,

Best regards,

Mahasen Dehideniya 

Reference

Rue, H., Martino, S., & Chopin, N. (2009). Approximate Bayesian inference for latent Gaussian models by using integrated nested Laplace approximations. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B (Statistical Methodology),
